Load libraries
```{r}
library(CellTFusion)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(123)
```

```{r}
load("data_LP.Rdata")
counts.norm.log.LP = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = T)
```

Load data
```{r}
counts = read.delim("~/Documents/LungPredict_late_stage/Data/Captier/TIPIT_RNA_TPM_134.txt")
clinical = read.delim("~/Documents/LungPredict_late_stage/Data/Captier/TIPIT_reponse_134.txt")
```

Processed data
```{r}
counts = counts %>%
  dplyr::select(-GeneID) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene_name, .keep_all = T) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("gene_name")

clinical = clinical %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Batch = as.numeric(counts[1,])) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("patient_ID")
  
counts = counts[-1,rownames(clinical)]
```

Add treatment
```{r}
treatment = read.csv("~/Documents/LungPredict_late_stage/Data/Captier/clinical_targets.csv", row.names = 1) 
treatment = treatment[rownames(treatment)%in%rownames(clinical),]
all.equal(rownames(treatment), rownames(clinical))
clinical = clinical %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Treatment = treatment$chemotherapy) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment == 0)
counts = counts[,colnames(counts)%in%rownames(clinical)]
```

Log normalized
```{r}
counts.norm.log = log(counts + 1)
```

Gene sets
```{r}
genesets = readRDS("group_marker_genesets.rds")
tfs = scale(compute.TFs.activity(counts.norm.log))
sig_scores = compute.pathway.activity(t(tfs), gene_sets = genesets)[[2]]
#sig_scores = compute.pathway.activity(counts.norm.log, gene_sets = genesets)[[2]]
patient_group <- apply(sig_scores, 1, function(x) names(which.max(x)))
clinical$group = patient_group
```

Function for survival analysis
```{r}
compute.survival.analysis = function(survival.data, time_unit) {
  library(survival)

  # Prepare the data for survival analysis
  data_for_model <- data.frame("time" = survival.data$PFS,
                               "status" = survival.data$PFS_bin) 
  
  data_for_model$coxHL <- survival.data$group

  # Perform Kaplan-Meier based on coxHL
  km_fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(time, status) ~ coxHL, data = data_for_model)
  
  pval <- survminer::surv_pvalue(km_fit, data = data_for_model)$pval #Performs log-rank test to see whether both survival curves are significantly different
  
  ### Set colors of each curve with the correct order 
  strata_names <- gsub("coxHL=", "", names(km_fit$strata)) 
  legend_labels <- strata_names
  legend.labs = legend_labels

  pdf("Results/SurvPlot_DEG_groups", width = 10, height = 5, onefile = FALSE)
  print(survminer::ggsurvplot(km_fit,
                   data = data_for_model,
                   size = 1,
                   conf.int.style = "step",
                   pval = TRUE,
                   risk.table = TRUE,
                   risk.table.col = "strata",
                   legend.labs = legend.labs,
                   risk.table.height = 0.3,
                   ggtheme = theme_grey(),
                   title = paste0("Cox PH for Surv(time, status) ~ patient groups"),
                   xlab = paste0("Time to death/recurrence/progression (", time_unit, ")")
  ))
  dev.off()

}
```

Compute survival analysis
```{r}
res_clusters = compute.survival.analysis(clinical, "months")
```

Batch effect

```{r}
lp_gobbini = coldata %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Samples")%>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cohort = "LP") %>%
  dplyr::select(Samples, Cohort)
lp_curie = clinical %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Samples")%>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cohort = "Curie") %>%
  dplyr::select(Samples, Cohort)
clinical_all = rbind(lp_gobbini, lp_curie)

############################
counts.norm.log.LP = counts.norm.log.LP[rownames(counts.norm.log.LP)%in%rownames(counts.norm.log),]
counts.norm.log = counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%rownames(counts.norm.log.LP),]

counts_all = cbind(counts.norm.log.LP, counts.norm.log)
```

Batch effect - PCA
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify) 
# Ensure Groups is in the data
df_plot <- as.data.frame(t(counts_all))
df_plot$Groups <- factor(clinical_all$Cohort)  # add Groups column

# Run PCA
counts_scaled <- t(counts_all)
# remove genes with zero variance
counts_scaled <- counts_scaled[, apply(counts_scaled, 2, var) != 0]

pca_result <- prcomp(counts_scaled, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Plot PCA
autoplot(pca_result, data = df_plot, 
         colour = 'Groups',   # column name as string
         label = FALSE, 
         size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("PCA") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
  labs(colour = "Cohorts")
```

tfs_all = rbind(tfs_LP, tfs)
  
library(ggplot2)
